evidence.reason: At the current tip, `list()` runs `gh pr list --limit 200` and accepts the resulting array without checking whether the fetch was capped. Since `gh pr list --limit` is a maximum-fetch limit, repositories with more than 200 open PRs silently receive a truncated inventory, and later rows are neither validated nor returned. This is an ordinary correctness gap in the existing inventory behavior; it does not depend on a new contract clause.
